slides.heading: Get it checked if you notice

caption:
Two months into new-dad life, Lulu's thumb aches every time he lifts the baby. Tools? Fine. Bub? Ouch.

Pain at the base of the thumb or thumb side of the wrist often builds when those tendons get more load than they're used to. New parents and heavy phone users see it heaps.

Lift your baby with palms facing up, supporting under the bottom and head, rather than scooping under the arms with thumbs spread. Hold your phone in both hands and scroll with your index finger. Most people improve over a few weeks with the right changes.

Pain after a fall, ongoing swelling or numb fingers should be checked promptly. Our Chatswood and Sydney CBD physios can help. Book online via the link in bio 👶
